faq.q: What do the 'Held', 'scheduled' and 'date not announced' labels on each exam mean?
faq.a: Each exam carries a status. 'Held' means it was conducted on that date (shown with a ✅). 'Scheduled' (📅) means the date is officially announced. 'Date not announced' (⚠️) means the shown date is only an estimate, like NABARD or BPSC where notifications were awaited. The tool deliberately distinguishes these so a cancelled-and-retested NEET doesn't look identical to a confirmed exam.

faq.q: How do I get my starred exams into my phone's calendar?
faq.a: Star the exams you want, then click 'Export .ics'. The tool writes an iCalendar file with one all-day VEVENT per starred exam, including the exam name, detail, note and official website in the description. Import that .ics into Google Calendar, Apple Calendar or Outlook and each exam becomes an event you can set alarms on.

faq.q: Can I track exams that aren't in the built-in list?
faq.a: Yes. Click '+ Add Custom Exam', enter a name and a date, and it's saved and auto-starred. Custom entries appear alongside the 60+ built-in exams in list, calendar and My Exams views, and are included in the .ics, CSV and JSON exports. They're stored locally under the ec_custom_v1 key in your browser.

faq.q: Where is my starred and custom data stored, and can I back it up?
faq.a: Starred exams (ec_starred_v1) and custom exams (ec_custom_v1) live in your browser's local storage, not on a server. If storage is full or blocked (private browsing), you'll see an inline warning that it couldn't save. Use the 'JSON Backup' button to download a file containing your starred and custom data with a timestamp.
